summary: IRYS ~$0.039, -52% in 24h and about -68% from its squeeze peak, with a further -24% hourly dump around 01:00 UTC. Posts point to a scheduled unlock of ~77.6m IRYS (about 3.9% of float) due today, 25 Oct, on top of concentrated holdings and fading open interest after ~$55m of short liquidations drove the pump. Buzz is still elevated but bearish. Down from -0.25.
